qualification.education_qualification: Post Graduate Degree, 12th + Diploma (MLT/DMLT/Engg) or Graduate Degree, Four-year Nursing Course.
qualification.details: Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical): Post Graduate Degree, including integrated PG degrees. For Engineering/IT/CS: Four-year Graduate Degree. Desirable: Laboratory/research experience in Clinical Bacteriology, particularly antimicrobial susceptibility testing (AST), broth microdilution (BMD), MIC determination, strain maintenance and related laboratory quality-control activities. Project Technical Support II: 12th in Science + Diploma (MLT/DMLT/Engineering or equivalent) + five years' experience in relevant subject/field OR Three-year Graduate Degree in relevant subject/field + two years' experience in relevant subject/field. As per ICMR OM on rationalization of PTS-I/PTS-II eligibility (June 2026), candidates possessing a Post-Graduate degree in the relevant discipline are eligible without mandatory work experience; a Master's degree acquired beyond the prescribed Bachelor's qualification is treated at par with the required experience duration. Desirable: Experience in clinical bacteriology research, AST/BMD, media and antibiotic stock preparation, strain preservation, laboratory equipment handling, inventory management and computer applications. Project Nurse III: Four-year Nursing Course. Desirable: Experience in antimicrobial stewardship, prescription audits, clinical research/data collection and patient-outcome assessment. Good working proficiency in English, Telugu and Hindi is desirable for patient communication.

salary_details.details: Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical): ₹56,000/- + HRA, as admissible Project Technical Support II: ₹20,000/- + HRA, as admissible Project Nurse III: ₹28,000/- + HRA, as admissible

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Mangalagiri Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical): Post Graduate Degree, including integrated PG degrees. For Engineering/IT/CS: Four-year Graduate Degree. Desirable: Laboratory/research experience in Clinical Bacteriology, particularly antimicrobial susceptibility testing (AST), broth microdilution (BMD), MIC determination, strain maintenance and related laboratory quality-control activities. Project Technical Support II: 12th in Science + Diploma (MLT/DMLT/Engineering or equivalent) + five years' experience in relevant subject/field OR Three-year Graduate Degree in relevant subject/field + two years' experience in relevant subject/field. As per ICMR OM on rationalization of PTS-I/PTS-II eligibility (June 2026), candidates possessing a Post-Graduate degree in the relevant discipline are eligible without mandatory work experience; a Master's degree acquired beyond the prescribed Bachelor's qualification is treated at par with the required experience duration. Desirable: Experience in clinical bacteriology research, AST/BMD, media and antibiotic stock preparation, strain preservation, laboratory equipment handling, inventory management and computer applications. Project Nurse III: Four-year Nursing Course. Desirable: Experience in antimicrobial stewardship, prescription audits, clinical research/data collection and patient-outcome assessment. Good working proficiency in English, Telugu and Hindi is desirable for patient communication.
